items.title: What Is CrowdStrike Holdings (CRWD) Adding With Its New AI Governance Integration?
items.summary: CrowdStrike Holdings (NasdaqGS:CRWD) and Theta Lake announced a new AI governance telemetry integration for the CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM platform. The integration allows security teams to correlate AI interaction data with broader security events and workflows. Organizations can apply automated retention policies to AI interaction records to support oversight and compliance needs.
